name: accordion
accessibility: Native <details>/<summary>: Enter/Space toggles and the open state is announced natively. `type="single"` keeps one item open (native exclusive accordion).
example:
<Accordion type="single">
  <AccordionItem title="What is cherry?" defaultOpen>A React design system in plain CSS.</AccordionItem>
  <AccordionItem title="Does it need client JS?">Only where a component is interactive.</AccordionItem>
</Accordion>
